title: Detailed fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#2b1a4a' />

  <rect x='20' y='22' width='56' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8d8e8' />

  <rect x='56' y='22' width='3' height='10' fill='#e8f0ff' />
  <rect x='66' y='22' width='3' height='10' fill='#e8f0ff' />

  <rect x='42' y='42' width='10' height='10' rx='1' fill='#a8e0ff' opacity='0.5' />

  <rect x='48' y='50' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffe040' />
  <!-- headlight -->
  <rect x='82' y='52' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffe040' />

  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='6' fill='#8890a0' />
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#c8d0d8' />
  <circle cx='55' cy='72' r='10' fill='#303040' />
  <circle cx='55' cy='72' r='6' fill='#8890a0' />
  <circle cx='55' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#c8d0d8' />
  <circle cx='80' cy='72' r='10' fill='#303040' />

  <rect x='28' y='42' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#f8f8f8' />
